name: Dark Elves
source: Warmaster Armies v2.26, Dark Elf army list
sourceNote: Profiles, min/max, special rules, and spells are from the Dark Elf selector in Warmaster Armies v2.26. Mounts are options on characters. One magic item per character and one magic standard per unit.

specialRules.name: Repeating crossbow
specialRules.text: Crossbowmen and Dark Riders shoot once at ranges up to 30cm and twice at ranges up to 15cm. A unit of three stands shoots 6 Attacks at a target within 15cm and 3 Attacks at a target at greater ranges. Units may shoot at enemies that charge them, in which case they shoot 1 Attack per stand regardless of range.

specialRules.name: Witch Elves
specialRules.text: A unit of Witch Elves always uses its initiative to charge an enemy if possible and cannot be given orders instead. Witch Elves never use their initiative to evade. The unit cannot be driven back by shooting and never rolls for drive backs. If victorious in combat they must pursue or advance where possible. Witch Elves are unaffected by enemies that cause terror in combat and do not suffer the usual -1 Attack modifier.

specialRules.name: Cold One Knights
specialRules.text: Cold One Knights have an Attack value bonus of +1 in the first round of each combat when fighting to the front: the stand has to touch the enemy in its arc of sight with its frontal edge and/or frontal corners. They cannot form brigades except with other units of Cold One Knights.

specialRules.name: Harpies
specialRules.text: Harpies are based facing the long edge of the base, in the same way as infantry, rather than the short edge like other monsters. Harpies can fly. A unit of Harpies cannot be joined by a character.

specialRules.name: War Hydra
specialRules.text: War Hydras cannot be included in a brigade, not even with other War Hydras. They cause terror. The War Hydra can breathe fire with a range of 20cm and 2 Attacks worked out in the normal way. Once all hits have been struck for that round, and assuming it has not been slain, the War Hydra automatically regenerates 1 hit that it suffered that round. A hit that is inflicted and then regenerated still counts towards the results for that round.

specialRules.name: Bolt Thrower
specialRules.text: Dark Elf Bolt Throwers are Elven Bolt Throwers. See the main rulebook, p.75.

specialRules.name: Dark Elf General
specialRules.text: If a Dark Elf Hero or Sorceress rolls a double 6 when issuing orders, the General must either lose 1 level of Command (for example from 10 to 9) or execute the failed underling. An executed character is removed as a casualty but does not count towards the enemy's victory points. If the General rolls a blunder (a double 6), the General automatically loses 1 level. A General can only drop 2 levels, to a minimum of 8. After that, subordinates who blunder are executed, and a blunder rolled by the General only ends the phase as normal.

specialRules.name: Manticore
specialRules.text: Generals, Heroes, and the Sorceress can ride a Manticore. The Manticore can fly, increasing the rider's movement to 100cm. An extra +2 Attacks are added to those of the rider. A unit joined by the character causes terror.

specialRules.name: Cauldron of Blood
specialRules.text: A Sorceress can have a Cauldron of Blood. She suffers a movement reduction to 30cm. The army can only ever include one Cauldron of Blood, and only if there is at least 1 unit of Witch Elves. The Cauldron adds +2 Attacks to the Sorceress and can add +1 to her dice roll to cast a spell once per battle. Announce that the bonus is being used before rolling to cast.

spells.name: Doom Bolt
spells.text: A bolt of pure malicious darkness arcs from the Sorceress's fingertip and stabs towards the foes of the Dark Elves. Draw an imaginary line 30cm long from the Sorceress's stand in any direction. The line passes through intervening units, but not beyond terrain that would normally stop a missile shot, such as the crest of a hill or more than 2cm of woodland. Each unit under the line takes three shooting attacks. This can affect several units, including your own. Unengaged units can be driven back, even friends. Engaged units cannot be driven back, but hits carry over into the first round of combat and count as having been struck in the combat itself.

spells.name: Black Horror
spells.text: A whirling vortex of dark energy surrounds and drags its victims into the infernal realms of Khaine, the Lord of Murder. Cast on an enemy unit the Sorceress can see that is not engaged in combat. The unit suffers 4 Attacks with no armour saves. Hits do not cause a drive back.

spells.name: Dominion
spells.text: Upon invoking the curse of Khaine, an unnatural and unbearable agony suffuses his foes. Cast on any enemy unit within range, whether or not the Sorceress can see it. The spell lasts until the end of the opposing player's next turn. Whilst it lasts, the unit cannot charge, and if engaged it will not pursue or advance. Even units otherwise obliged to charge, pursue, or advance will not do so.

spells.name: Soul Stealer
spells.text: Invoking the daemons of the abyss, the Sorceress tears the souls from her enemies. She can cast this if she has joined a unit in combat, on one enemy unit touching that unit. The target takes three attacks. Targets get no armour save: all Armour values count as 0. Hits carry over into the first round of combat and count as having been struck in the first round.
